collections.name: Primitives
collections.purpose: Raw values: the colour palette, the 4px spacing scale, radius, stroke, opacity, font families and weights. Hidden from publishing and from pickers so designers bind semantic or component variables instead.
collections.modeRationale: No modes. Raw values never change by context.

collections.name: Semantic
collections.purpose: What a colour is FOR (background, text, border, link, focus, status, button). Aliases to Primitives.
collections.modeRationale: Inverse mirrors the web system's .surface-inverse scope (footer, promo bar, dark sections): 11 roles change, the rest keep their value. Set a frame's variable mode to Inverse and every bound fill, stroke and text colour inside re-resolves, including dependents (the web build had to re-declare those by hand). There is no site-wide dark mode in the web system, so there is no Dark mode here either.

collections.name: Layout
collections.purpose: Page gutters, grid gaps, header height, section spacing, containers and the reference frame widths.
collections.modeRationale: The web system has exactly three layout tiers (0 to 599, 600 to 1023, 1024 and up) and six tokens that change by tier. Figma has no media queries, so the three modes stand for those tiers: set the mode on a page frame and every bound gutter, gap and section padding follows. Fluid values (section spacing) are sampled at the reference widths 360, 768 and 1280.

collections.name: Typography
collections.purpose: Font sizes in px, one variable per text role.
collections.modeRationale: The nine web font sizes are fluid (clamp), and Figma has no equivalent: each is sampled at the three reference widths and rounded to a whole pixel. The twelve static sizes hold the same value in every mode. Kept separate from Layout so a text frame and a layout frame can be set to different modes if a design needs it.

collections.name: Components
collections.purpose: Only component-specific values that are shared across components or must stay in sync with the web tokens: touch target, control heights, icon sizes, choice and swatch sizes, focus ring.
collections.modeRationale: No modes. Component values do not change by context; responsive differences come from the Layout collection.
